ms.text:
MP1
(Metre) rule / tape measure
MP2
Release ball to roll down track, measure how far it travels.
MP3
Repeat for at least 2 more different angles of right-hand side of track
MP4
Clear identification of the correct distance to be measured (e.g. from table leg or other point identified on floor to
point of impact with track)
OR clear explanation of how to identify point of impact (e.g. using a sand tray)
MP5
Constant variable identified
Release height for ball
Or same ball every time / same weight / mass / size of ball
MP6
Table consistent with their method (if method correct with columns for distance travelled and angle of track, with
units)
MP7
Analysis based on their table
Graph of angle against distance travelled, or compare angle with distance travelled (or the equivalents for their
method)
